FrozenPolicy: ChunkPublication; Message129WhenBeneficial; selective message148 LZ4 canonical>=384/saving>=32; V3 production cadence 1/2/4; CrossLane cap 2; Game manifest v29; transport revision 2
RemotePublicationPreparationDefinition: RemotePublicationPreparation is the exact opt-in ChunkPublicationStore interval which groups current-tick source changes and creates shared prepared publications/records. The encompassing ApplyAuthority interval also owns ordinary public-world commit/reconciliation and is not charged wholesale to the remote budget.
ServerOwnedRemoteReplicationBudgetDefini: ServerOwnedRemoteReplicationBudget is formed for every tick by summing that tick's non-overlapping RemotePublicationPreparation, RecipientCommitObservation, and NetworkAndRemoteReplication ticks, then calculating distributions over the resulting samples. No phase percentiles are added.
InputNormalizationLimitation: The V3 normalized replication fixture applies equivalent authoritative movement mutations directly. V2 reapplied held movement intent every server tick, so the 35-percent active mutation shape is appropriate even though new inputs arrived at 20 Hz. V3 does not emit input-command messages here; modeled input counts remain labels, not measured V3 transport work.
SemanticFamilyNormalizationLimitation: V3's current public-world record is one unified latest-state family. The historical V2 run independently published movement, visual, bulk, and ordered-event families. Exact semantic-family parity is therefore unavailable without inventing a non-production V3 protocol.
SpatialDensityNormalizationLimitation: V2 used a 1 m, 20-column grid. That can place more than V3's bounded 64 public records in one 16 m publication chunk and is rejected during baseline. The closest admissible V3 fixture uses a 2 m, 20-column grid, retaining dense overlap while keeping every publication chunk within its production bound. V2's active clients were the first 35% of indices; V3 distributes the same active ratio across that grid because concentrating them can create one canonical per-chunk delta larger than the production Game-message limit.

HistoricalV2.EntityOwnership: One session-owned ECS movement entity per accepted client; no separate ambient 1,000-entity population is created by the harness.
HistoricalV2.TimingBoundary: Main tick includes in-process client work. Async previous flush is separately reported and cannot be percentile-added to main tick.

HistoricalV2Sharded.TimingBoundary: Dedicated server process plus four client worker processes. Server tick and previous background send are independent distributions and are not added.

ContemporaryV2.Result: The unchanged archived build fails because current repository-wide MSBuild output rules cause archived generated obj trees to be included twice, producing duplicate TargetFramework and assembly attributes. No V2 source or project file was modified to obtain a contemporary number.
